QuestInfo.name: Supporting Heliseum Reclamation HQ
QuestInfo.0: #b#p3000002##k, the leader of the Nova council is looking for Kaiser. Go to #b#m400000000##k and see #b#p3000002##k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3000002##k says that the #b#m401000000##k, which was established to take back the capital, is in grave danger due to the  Specter army's attacks. Use the portal near the #beastern exit of #m400000000##k to go to #b#m401000002##k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with a Nova scout named #b#p3001107##k who seeks help near #b#m401000002##k. #b#p3001107##k said that he was waiting for Kaiser to be dispatched and asked for your assistance.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 70,725
Can proceed to the Heliseum Reclamation HQ in Danger quest

0.0: Ah, allow me to fill you in. You are most certainly aware of the recent establishment of the #b#m401000000##k, which we are using as a base of operations in our attempts to reclaim our capital? \r\n#L0##bOf course.#l\n#k
0.1: Well, it is under attack. Specters have consistently bogged down our attempts throughout its construction, and continue to be a hindrance to this very day.\r\n#L0##bWe cannot let those Specters stop us from getting Heliseum back. #l\n#k
0.2: Indeed. That is why I want you, the Guardian of Nova, to help us resolve the crisis.\r\n#L0##bWhat do I need to do? #l\n#k
0.3: I want you to lead a small support squad in an effort to crush the Specter forces while they are distracted.\r\n#L0##bThis is an honor, and a privilege.#l\n#k
0.4: It is, young guardian. So, will you help us? This is the first step in reclaiming our proud heritage.

yes.0: Spoken like the true guardian of Nova. Hurry to the #b#m401000000##k and lend them your power. There is a direct portal near the #beastern entrance of #m400000000##k that will take you to the #b#m401000002##k.

no.0: This is a matter for the entire Nova race. It cannot be set aside so frivolously.

1.0: You've come! Finally! I've been hiding here, trying not to wet my pants. I'm no good in a fight! I'm just a scout!

default.0: Hurry to the #b#m401000000##k. Use the portal at the #beastern entrance of #m400000000##k to go to the #b#m401000002##k. That will put you in front of HQ.
